description: A query in the reconstruction keeps the query policy of engine §4: stage-wide maximal does not apply in it. So probe reads chunk as A, omits T, and reads B, and the chosen a survives beside c (engine §7.6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only maximal
%elidable U
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a $x(pair) [U]
%conditions begins($x, probe)
%rule b pair [U] [U]
%rule c pair U
%rule pair A B
%rule probe chunk [T] B
%rule chunk A | A B
